senses.gloss: m. (preced.), pl. שְׁחָקִים, שְׁחָקִין worn garments, thin clothes. Sifra Thazr., Neg., Par. 4, ch. XV בקרחתו אלו הש׳ ‘in its baldness’ (Lev. XIII, 55), that means old clothes (whose nap is worn off).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 5:8">Keth. V, 8</cite> <he>אין נותנין לה … ולא ש׳ וכ׳</he> we must not give her new garments for summer and worn-out (thin) garments for winter; <cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 5:8">ib.</cite> <he>והש׳ שלה</he> and the discarded garments remain hers; v. <cite ref="B00807"><he>בְּלָאוֹת</he></cite>.
